wf_basalt_cliff.notes: Cliff of faceted basalt columns, front faces -Y (glTF +Z); place over steep terrain, base sinks 3 m below the pivot for slopes. Notch at x -4.4..4.4 with a lip slab at z 40 (front edge y -3.1): put wf_fall_tall at cliff-local (0, -1.6, 0), same yaw, wf_mist and wf_rainbow in front of it.

wf_basalt_cliff_low.notes: Lower cliff with a stepped top (high on -X, low on +X), front faces -Y; base sinks 3 m. Notch at x 1.3..6.7 with a lip slab at z 16 (front edge y -3.1): put wf_fall_mid at cliff-local (4.0, -1.9, 0).

wf_basalt_columns.notes: Cluster of 9 basalt columns 0.5-6 m tall for pool edges and stepping; pivot at the cluster centre, base sinks 1 m.

wf_fall_tall.notes: Tall fall sheet, front faces -Y. Pivot is the bottom centre at the pool surface (z 0); the lip is at z 40, 1.5 m toward -Y. fx_water UVs: V 0 at the lip, 4 repeats to the bottom (scroll V). Foam skirt at the base. Pair with wf_basalt_cliff (see its notes) and wf_mist.

wf_fall_mid.notes: Mid fall, 5 m wide and 16 m tall, front faces -Y. Pivot bottom centre at the pool surface; lip at z 16, 1.2 m toward -Y. V 0 at the lip, 10 m per V. Pairs with wf_basalt_cliff_low.

wf_cascade_steps.notes: Five basalt ledges (2.4 m rise, 2 m deep) with water spilling forward toward -Y into the pool at z 0; top ledge at z 12 at the back (+Y). Box collider covers the whole rock mass; base sinks 2 m.

wf_mist.notes: Soft mist mound for the base of a fall (fx_water, pale; V = 0 at the top, 1 at the pool, so a scroll drifts it slowly). Pivot on the pool surface; place under the fall with its back (+Y) against the sheet. Decorative.

wf_rainbow.notes: Purely decorative: a thin 7-band rainbow arc (fx_glow), 16 m wide, 10 m tall, in the XZ plane facing -Y. Ends dip 0.6 m below the pivot so they vanish into mist; place in the spray in front of a fall.

wf_crystals.notes: Glowing blue crystal cluster (fx_glow) on a dark slate seat, 1.5 m tall. Pool edges, between rim slabs.

wf_crystals_small.notes: Small glowing crystal cluster, 0.8 m tall.

wf_rim_slabs.notes: Flat irregular stone slabs edging a pool, 6 x 3 m, ~0.4 m tall; the pool side is -Y. Walkable: the box is low (0.4 m) so use it only if the controller steps up 0.4 m, otherwise treat as ground.

wf_stone_steps.notes: Stone-slab stair, 2.5 m wide, rising 2.5 m over 4 m from -Y (bottom, front) to +Y (top), with mossy kerb stones. No collider: give it a ramp collider or let the terrain carry the slope.

wf_fern.notes: Fern clump ~1.6 m across with arching fronds. Ledges, pool edges, cliff bases.

wf_vines.notes: Curtain of hanging vines 3 m wide, up to 5 m long. Pivot at the TOP (the mossy roll that sits on a ledge edge); hangs down -Z with leaves facing -Y. Place on cliff ledges.

wf_rope_bridge.notes: Rope-and-plank suspension bridge spanning X: end posts at x +-25, deck 1.8 m wide, sagging 3 m to z -3 at mid-span. Pivot at the middle of the span at anchor height (deck ends at z 0); anchor stakes at x +-27.2. No collider: build a walk collider along the deck curve z = -3 * (1 - (x / 25)^2).

wf_pine.notes: Tall slender cliff-top pine, 16 m; cylinder collider is the trunk.
